summary: Eagle Point Trinity Senior Secured Lending Co filed an 8-K reporting an unregistered sale of 46,277.49 common shares on August 3, 2026, for aggregate proceeds of $473,993 (approximately $10.24 per share), exempt under Section 4(a)(2), Regulation D, and/or Regulation S. The filing also discloses the July 31, 2026, net asset value per share of $10.24. This is a routine private placement of equity securities by a closed-end fund, not a special situation. No strategic transaction, tender offer, or unusual corporate event is present. The filing is a standard current report with no implications for special-situations analysis.
